remarks: This is the home you've been waiting for-spacious, classic, and designed for effortless living. This 4,500 sq. ft. four-bedroom Colonial perfectly blends timeless style with modern comfort. The open floor plan flows beautifully, offering move-in ready spaces for today's lifestyle. A first-floor study with a wall of built-ins and a full bath provides the perfect work-from-home retreat. The expansive family room, with its fireplace, cathedral ceiling, and custom built-ins, opens to a handsome deck-ideal for indoor-outdoor living. The elegant foyer sets the tone, leading to a formal living room with another fireplace, built-ins, and abundant natural light. The DR will be well used as it has a bow window which brings in the beautiful views over this special setting. The kitchen is both functional and stylish, featuring an oversized island, separate breakfast room, and all the essentials for gatherings large and small. Upstairs, you'll find four generous bedrooms, including a primary suite with a spa-like bath enhanced by heated floors. The lower level extends the living space with two recreation rooms and a separate laundry room. A whole-house generator provides peace of mind. Set on four lush and private acres along sought-after West Road, the property combines serenity with convenience-just two minutes to markets, banks, and everyday amenities. Truly an exceptional opportunity to make this your forever home.
